title: React Native & Expo Router
summary: Expo SDK 52+, Expo Router, TypeScript, NativeWind, FlashList
rules: Follow Expo Router file-based navigation in app/ folder with typed routes.
Handle iOS and Android platform divergence using Platform.OS or .android.tsx/.ios.tsx extensions.
Always wrap screens in SafeAreaProvider and useSafeAreaInsets() for edge-to-edge layouts.
Never use raw ScrollView for long dynamic lists; use FlashList or FlatList with memoized render items.
Perform native animations on UI thread using react-native-reanimated.
